en.s: The Battle of Anzen or Dazimon was fought on 22 July 838 at Anzen or Dazimon (now Dazmana (Akçatarla), Turkey) between the Byzantine Empire and the forces of the Abbasid Caliphate. The Abbasids had launched a massive expedition with two separate armies in retaliation for the Byzantine emperor Theophilos's successes the previous year, and aimed to sack Amorion, one of Byzantium's largest cities.

zh.s: 安赞战役又称达齐蒙战役，于838年7月22日在安赞（或达齐蒙；今土耳其达兹马纳，即阿克恰塔尔拉）爆发，交战双方为拜占庭帝国和阿拔斯哈里发国军队。阿拔斯军此前发动大规模远征，分成两支军队，意在报复拜占庭皇帝狄奥斐洛斯前一年的军事胜利，并攻占拜占庭最大城市之一阿莫里翁。

en.s: The Massacre at Béziers occurred on 22 July 1209 during the sack of Béziers by Crusaders. It was the outcome of the Siege of Béziers, which was the first major military action of the Albigensian Crusade.

en.s: The (second) Battle of Bornhöved took place on 22 July 1227 near Bornhöved in Holstein. Count Adolf IV of Schauenburg and Holstein — leading an army consisting of troops from the cities of Lübeck and Hamburg, Dithmarschen, Holstein, and various Northern German nobles, defeated King Valdemar II of Denmark and the Welf Otto the Child.

zh.s: 第二次博恩霍夫德战役发生于1227年7月22日，地点在荷尔斯泰因的博恩霍夫德附近。绍恩堡和荷尔斯泰因伯爵阿道夫四世率领一支军队参战，军队由吕贝克、汉堡等城市的部队、迪特马申和荷尔斯泰因的兵力，以及北德各地贵族的部队组成。他击败了丹麦国王瓦尔德马二世和韦尔夫家族的孩童奥托。

en.s: The Battle of Taillebourg, a major medieval battle fought in July 1242, was the decisive engagement of the Saintonge War. It pitted a French Capetian army under the command of King Louis IX, also known as Saint Louis, and his younger brother Alphonse of Poitiers, against forces led by King Henry III of England, his brother Richard of Cornwall and their stepfather Hugh X of Lusignan.

zh.s: 塔耶堡战役是圣通日战争中的一场重要中世纪战役，于1242年7月爆发，是这场战争的决定性战斗。交战双方分别是法国卡佩王朝军队和英格兰军队。法军由路易九世（圣路易）及其弟普瓦捷的阿方斯指挥；英军由英格兰国王亨利三世、其弟康沃尔的理查及其继父休十世·德·吕济尼昂率领。

en.s: The Battle of Herat was fought between the Ilkhanid forces of Abaqa Khan and the invading Chagatai forces of Ghiyas-ud-din Baraq on 22 July 1270. The battle marked the climax of a broader power struggle within the fractured Mongol Empire, as former allies and competing ulus contended for supremacy in the aftermath of the Toluid Revolution and the succession crisis.

zh.s: 1270年7月22日，阿八哈汗率领的伊儿汗国军队与入侵的察合台军队交战，后者由吉亚斯丁·巴拉克率领。这场战役是蒙古帝国分裂后更大规模权力斗争的高潮。托雷家族权力斗争及继承危机之后，昔日盟友和彼此竞争的蒙古诸部都在争夺霸权。

en.s: The Battle of Falkirk (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr na h-Eaglaise Brice; Scots: Battle o Fawkirk), on 22 July 1298, was one of the major battles in the First War of Scottish Independence. Led by King Edward I of England, the English army defeated the Scots, led by William Wallace. Shortly after the battle Wallace resigned as Guardian of Scotland.

zh.s: 福尔柯克战役（苏格兰盖尔语：Blàr na h-Eaglaise Brice；苏格兰语：Battle o Fawkirk）发生于1298年7月22日，是苏格兰独立战争第一阶段中的一场重要战役。英格兰国王爱德华一世率军击败了威廉·华莱士率领的苏格兰军队。战后不久，华莱士辞去苏格兰守护者一职。

en.s: St. Mary Magdalene's flood (German: Magdalenenhochwasser / Magdalenenflut) was the largest recorded flood in central Europe with water levels exceeding those of the 2002 European floods. It occurred on and around the feast day of St. Mary Magdalene, 22 July in 1342. Following the passage of a Genoa low, the rivers Rhine, Moselle, Main, Danube, Weser, Werra, Unstrut, Elbe, Vltava and their tributaries inundated large areas.
en.n: St. Mary Magdalene's flood is the worst such event on record for central Europe.

zh.s: 圣抹大拉洪水（德语：Magdalenenhochwasser或Magdalenenflut）是中欧有记录以来最大的洪灾，水位超过2002年欧洲洪灾。洪水发生在1342年7月22日圣抹大拉节前后。热那亚低压过境后，莱茵河、摩泽尔河、美因河、多瑙河、威悉河、维拉河、翁斯特鲁特河、易北河、伏尔塔瓦河及其支流泛滥，大片地区被淹。
zh.n: 圣抹大拉洪水是中欧有记录以来最严重的同类灾害。

en.s: The Danish–Hanseatic War (1361–1370) was both a trade and territorial conflict mainly between the Kingdom of Denmark, led by King Valdemar IV, and the Hanseatic League, the latter of which was led by the rich and powerful merchant city of Lübeck. Though the first few years of the war resulted in several Danish victories, and even led to a beneficial truce for Denmark in 1365, the Hanseatic League, furious at the terms of the truce, resumed hostilities along with several allies and managed to defeat the Danes.

zh.s: 丹麦—汉萨战争（1361—1370年）是一场贸易和领土冲突，主要交战方为瓦尔德马四世统治下的丹麦王国，以及以富有而强大的吕贝克商人城市为首的汉萨同盟。战争头几年丹麦屡次获胜，并于1365年达成对丹麦有利的休战协议。汉萨同盟对休战条款不满，随后联合盟友恢复战事并击败丹麦军队。

en.s: The Battle of Yeavering (or Battle of Geteryne) was fought in 1415 between English and Scottish forces near Yeavering in Northumberland. A small English force consisting of 440 men led by the Earl of Westmoreland defeated 4000 Scots. Fought in the same year as the Battle of Agincourt, which famously demonstrated the efficacy of the longbow against cavalry, it is notable that the English side at Yeavering consisted mostly of archers.

zh.s: 耶弗林战役又称盖特林战役，发生于1415年，交战双方是英格兰和苏格兰军队，地点在诺森伯兰的耶弗林附近。威斯特摩兰伯爵率领的440名英军击败了4,000名苏格兰人。战役发生在阿金库尔战役同一年；阿金库尔战役曾充分显示长弓对骑兵的杀伤力。耶弗林战役的英军也以弓箭手为主。

en.s: The Battle of St. Jakob an der Sihl was a battle of the Old Zürich War that occurred on 22 July 1443, resulting in a defeat for Zürich. The battle took place outside the gates of Zürich, beyond the Sihl (today's Aussersihl district). The troops of Zürich, with Habsburg reinforcements, met the attacking confederates on the Sihlfeld north of St. Jakob on 21 July.

zh.s: 圣雅各布-锡尔河战役是旧苏黎世战争中的一场战斗，发生于1443年7月22日，苏黎世方面战败。战场位于苏黎世城门外、锡尔河对岸，也就是今天的奥瑟西尔区。7月21日，苏黎世军队在哈布斯堡援军支援下，于圣雅各布以北的锡尔费尔德与来袭的邦联军交战。

en.s: The Old Zurich War (German: Alter Zürichkrieg; 1440–1446) was a conflict between the canton of Zurich and the other seven cantons of the Old Swiss Confederacy over the succession to the Count of Toggenburg. In 1436, Count Friedrich VII of Toggenburg died, leaving neither heir nor will. The canton of Zurich, led by burgomaster Rudolf Stüssi, claimed the Toggenburg lands; the cantons of Schwyz and Glarus made counter-claims, backed by the other cantons. In 1438, Zurich occupied the disputed area and cut off grain supplies to Schwyz and Glarus. In 1440, the other cantons expelled Zurich from the confederation and declared war. Zurich retaliated by making an alliance with Frederick III, Holy Roman Emperor of the house of Habsburg. The forces of Zurich were defeated in the Battle of St. Jakob an der Sihl on 22 July 1443 and Zurich was besieged.

zh.s: 旧苏黎世战争（德语：Alter Zürichkrieg，1440—1446年）是苏黎世州与旧瑞士邦联其他七州之间的一场冲突，起因是托根堡伯爵的继承问题。1436年，腓特烈七世·冯·托根堡伯爵去世，没有留下继承人或遗嘱。苏黎世州由市长鲁道夫·施蒂西领导，声称拥有托根堡领地；施维茨州和格拉鲁斯州提出相反主张，并得到其他州支持。1438年，苏黎世占领争议地区，切断了对施维茨和格拉鲁斯的粮食供应。1440年，其他州将苏黎世逐出邦联并宣战。苏黎世则与哈布斯堡王朝的神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈三世结盟。1443年7月22日，苏黎世军队在圣雅各布-锡尔河战役中战败，苏黎世随后遭到围困。

zh.s: 贝尔格莱德围城战又称南多尔费赫尔堡围城战（匈牙利语：Nándorfehérvár ostroma或nándorfehérvári diadal，意为“南多尔费赫尔堡大捷”；塞尔维亚语西里尔字母：Опсада Београда，罗马化：Opsada Beograda），是1456年7月4日至22日对贝尔格莱德实施的一场军事封锁。1453年君士坦丁堡陷落后，奥斯曼帝国试图进一步向欧洲扩张。

en.s: The Battle of Lochmaben Fair was an engagement in Lochmaben, Scotland, on 22 July 1484 between Scottish loyalists to James III of Scotland and the rebels Alexander Stewart, Duke of Albany and James Douglas, 9th Earl of Douglas, leading cavalry from England. Both exiles from Scotland, Albany and Douglas invaded with permission but not support of Richard III of England, hoping to encourage rebellion against James. Instead, they were met with armed resistance. The loyalists took the day. Douglas was captured and Albany forced to retreat.

zh.s: 1484年7月22日，苏格兰洛赫马本发生战斗。苏格兰国王詹姆斯三世的支持者与叛军交战，叛军由奥尔巴尼公爵亚历山大·斯图亚特和道格拉斯伯爵詹姆斯·道格拉斯（第九代）率领，并带有从英格兰来的骑兵。两人均被流放出苏格兰；他们得到英格兰国王理查三世的许可，但没有得到他的支援，入侵苏格兰是希望煽动叛乱。结果他们遭到武装抵抗，詹姆斯三世的支持者获胜。道格拉斯被俘，奥尔巴尼被迫撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Dornach was a battle fought on 22 July 1499 between the troops of Emperor Maximilian I and the Old Swiss Confederacy close to the Swiss village of Dornach. The battle turned into a decisive defeat for Maximilian, and concluded the Swabian War between the Swiss and the Swabian League. On 19 July, Imperial troops marching on Dornach castle were sighted, and Solothurn called Bern for help. Bern sent 5000 troops, Zurich 400, and smaller contingents from Uri, Unterwalden and Zug also started to move to Dornach. On 20 July, 600 troops left Lucerne. The Austrians had about 16,000 troops.

zh.s: 1499年7月22日，神圣罗马帝国皇帝马克西米连一世的军队与旧瑞士邦联在瑞士村庄多尔纳赫附近交战。帝国军遭到决定性失败，瑞士与施瓦本联盟之间的施瓦本战争也由此结束。7月19日，帝国军向多尔纳赫城堡进军时被发现，索洛图恩随即向伯尔尼求援。伯尔尼派出5,000人，苏黎世派出400人；乌里、下瓦尔登、楚格等地也派出小股部队前往多尔纳赫。7月20日，另有600名士兵从卢塞恩出发。奥军约有16,000人。

en.s: The Bombardment of Reval (Swedish: Beskjutningen av Reval) was an attack carried out by a Dano-Lübeckian fleet against the town of Reval (modern-day Tallinn) in 1569 during the Northern Seven Years' War. The attack led to Peder Munk bringing home a large booty from plundering merchant ships. If he had landed his men in time, he would have been able to capture the city as well.

en.s: The Battle of Kaffa (modern Feodosia) in 1616, was a Cossack naval raid on Crimea and a subsequent battle over the city of Kaffa against the Ottoman garrison, during which Petro Sahaidachny led Zaporizhian Cossacks to victory.

zh.s: 1616年，哥萨克人对克里米亚发动海上突袭，随后又与奥斯曼守军争夺卡法城（今费奥多西亚）。在这场战斗中，彼得罗·萨哈伊达奇内率领扎波罗热哥萨克人获胜。

en.s: The Anglo-Scottish war (1650–1652), also known as the Third Civil War, was the final conflict in the Wars of the Three Kingdoms, a series of armed conflicts and political machinations between shifting alliances of religious and political factions in England, Scotland and Ireland. The 1650 English invasion of Scotland was a pre-emptive military incursion by the English Commonwealth's New Model Army, intended to allay the risk of Charles II invading England with a Scottish army.

zh.s: 英苏战争（1650—1652年）又称第三次内战，是三国战争的最后一场冲突。三国战争期间，英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰的宗教及政治派系结盟不断变化，彼此间爆发了一系列武装冲突和政治斗争。1650年，英格兰入侵苏格兰，这是英格兰共和国新模范军发动的一次先发制人行动，目的是避免查理二世率领苏格兰军队入侵英格兰。

en.s: The Battle of Ostrovica was a military engagement between the Austrians and the Ottomans during the Austro-Turkish War of 1737–1739. The Austrians attacked the Ostrovia castle; however, they were forced to retreat and, in turn, were attacked and routed by the Ottomans.

zh.s: 奥斯特罗维察战役是1737—1739年奥土战争期间奥地利与奥斯曼帝国之间的一场战斗。奥军袭击奥斯特罗维察城堡，但被迫撤退，随后遭到奥斯曼军队追击并击溃。

en.s: The Battle of Grocka, also known as Battle of Krotzka, (Turkish: Hisarcık Savaşı) was the decisive battle of the Austro-Turkish War (1737–1739). It was fought between the Habsburg Monarchy and the Ottoman Empire on 21–22 July 1739 in Grocka, near Belgrade in the Habsburg-held Kingdom of Serbia. The Ottomans were victorious, and proceeded with the Siege of Belgrade, that led to the conclusion of the Treaty of Belgrade on 18 September 1739.

zh.s: 格罗茨卡战役又称克罗茨卡战役（土耳其语：Hisarcık Savaşı），是1737—1739年奥土战争中的决定性战役。哈布斯堡君主国与奥斯曼帝国于1739年7月21日至22日在格罗茨卡交战；该地靠近贝尔格莱德，当时属于哈布斯堡治下的塞尔维亚王国。奥斯曼军获胜，随后围攻贝尔格莱德，并于1739年9月18日签订《贝尔格莱德条约》结束战争。

en.s: The siege of Dresden took place in July 1760 during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War) when a Prussian force led by Frederick the Great unsuccessfully besieged the city of Dresden in Saxony. Frederick had previously occupied Dresden in 1756 during his Invasion of Saxony, which had triggered the outbreak of war. In 1759 it had been taken back by Austria-led forces.

zh.s: 1760年7月，第三次西里西亚战争（七年战争的一部分）期间，腓特烈大帝率领的普鲁士军队围攻萨克森的德累斯顿，但未能攻下该城。腓特烈曾于1756年发动萨克森入侵并占领德累斯顿，这一行动引发了战争。1759年，奥地利领导的军队重新夺回该城。

en.s: The Battle of Minisink took place during the American Revolutionary War at Minisink Ford, New York, on July 22, 1779. It was the only major skirmish of the Revolutionary War fought in the upper Delaware River valley. The battle was a decisive Iroquois and Loyalist victory, as the Patriot militia was hastily assembled, ill-equipped and inexperienced.

zh.s: 米尼斯克战役是美国独立战争期间的一场战斗，1779年7月22日发生在纽约州米尼斯克浅滩。这是独立战争期间上特拉华河谷发生的唯一一场较大规模交战。爱国者民兵仓促集结、装备不足、缺乏经验，因此易洛魁人和效忠派取得决定性胜利。

en.t: Battle of Santa Cruz de Tenerife (1797)
en.s: The Battle of Santa Cruz de Tenerife was an amphibious assault by the Royal Navy on the Spanish port city of Santa Cruz de Tenerife in the Canary Islands. Launched by Rear-Admiral Horatio Nelson on 22 July 1797, the assault was defeated, and on 25 July the remains of the landing party withdrew under a truce, having lost several hundred men. Nelson himself had been wounded in the arm, which was subsequently partially amputated: a stigma that he carried to his grave as a constant reminder of his failure.

zh.t: 圣克鲁斯-德特内里费战役（1797年）
zh.s: 英国皇家海军于1797年7月22日对西班牙加那利群岛的圣克鲁斯-德特内里费港发动两栖突袭，由海军少将霍雷肖·纳尔逊率领，但遭到击退。7月25日，登陆部队残部在停战协议下撤退，损失数百人。纳尔逊本人手臂受伤，后来部分截肢；这次失败成为他终生难忘的污点。

en.s: In the Battle of Cape Finisterre (22 July 1805) off Galicia, Spain, the British fleet under Admiral Robert Calder fought an indecisive naval battle against the combined Franco-Spanish fleet which was returning from the West Indies. Failing to prevent the joining of French Admiral Pierre de Villeneuve's fleet to the squadron of Ferrol and to strike the shattering blow that would have freed Great Britain from the danger of an invasion, Calder was later court-martialled and severely reprimanded for his failure and for avoiding the renewal of the engagement on 23 and 24 July.

zh.s: 1805年7月22日，西班牙加利西亚近海发生菲尼斯特雷角海战。罗伯特·考尔德海军上将率领的英国舰队与一支从西印度群岛返航的法西联合舰队交战，双方未分胜负。考尔德未能阻止法国海军上将皮埃尔·德·维尔纳夫的舰队与费罗尔分舰队会合，也未能重创敌军、消除英国遭入侵的威胁。后来，考尔德因未能达成目标、并避免在7月23日和24日重启战斗而受到军事法庭审判和严厉训斥。

en.s: The Battle of Salamanca (in French and Spanish known as "Battle of Arapiles") saw an Anglo-Portuguese army under the Duke of Wellington defeat Marshal Auguste Marmont's French forces among the hills around Arapiles, south of Salamanca, Spain on 22 July 1812 during the Peninsular War. A Spanish division was also present but took no part in the battle. The battle involved a succession of flanking manoeuvres in oblique order, initiated by the British heavy cavalry brigade and Pakenham's 3rd division, and continued by the cavalry and the 4th, 5th and 6th divisions. These attacks resulted in a rout of the French left wing.

zh.s: 半岛战争期间，威灵顿公爵率领的英葡联军于1812年7月22日在西班牙萨拉曼卡以南的阿拉皮莱斯丘陵击败奥古斯特·马尔蒙元帅指挥的法军。这场战役在法语和西班牙语中称为“阿拉皮莱斯战役”。西班牙一支师级部队也在场，但没有参战。战斗中，英军重骑兵旅和帕肯汉姆的第3师率先发动一系列斜向侧翼机动，随后骑兵以及第4、第5和第6师继续进攻，最终击溃法军左翼。

en.s: The Battle of Los Horcones, part of the Admirable Campaign, was a military conflict in the Spanish American wars of independence fought on July 22, 1813 between the pro-independence forces led by José Félix Ribas and Spanish royalist troops under colonel Francisco Oberto at the plain of Los Horcones. Ribas was victorious, capturing much of the Spanish equipment and capturing more than 300 prisoners.

zh.s: 洛斯奥尔科内斯战役是“令人钦佩的战役”行动的一部分，属于西属美洲独立战争，于1813年7月22日在洛斯奥尔科内斯平原爆发。何塞·费利克斯·里巴斯率领的独立派部队与西班牙王党军交战，后者由弗朗西斯科·奥韦托上校指挥。里巴斯获胜，缴获了大批西班牙军需物资，并俘虏300多人。

en.s: The Battle of Atlanta was a battle of the Atlanta Campaign fought during the American Civil War on July 22, 1864, just southeast of Atlanta, Georgia. Continuing their summer campaign to seize the important rail and supply center of Atlanta, Union forces commanded by William T. Sherman overwhelmed and defeated Confederate forces defending the city under John B. Hood. Union Maj. Gen. James B. McPherson was killed during the battle. Despite the implication of finality in its name, the battle occurred midway through the campaign, and the city did not fall until September 2, 1864, after a Union siege and various attempts to seize railroads and supply lines leading to Atlanta.

zh.s: 亚特兰大战役是美国内战期间亚特兰大攻势中的一场战斗，发生于1864年7月22日，地点在亚特兰大东南方。威廉·T·谢尔曼率领的联邦军继续夏季战役，试图夺取亚特兰大这一重要铁路和补给中心，并击败了约翰·B·胡德率领的邦联守军。联邦军少将詹姆斯·B·麦克弗森在战斗中阵亡。尽管战役名称听起来像是最终决战，实际它发生在战役行动中期；亚特兰大直到1864年9月2日、在联邦军围城并多次试图夺取通往该城的铁路和补给线后才陷落。

It fell on 26 July 1868. It can be considered the key event of the Paraguayan War since the fortress had frustrated the allied advance into Paraguay for more than two years.

en.s: Paris–Rouen, Le Petit Journal Horseless Carriages Contest (Concours du 'Petit Journal' Les Voitures sans Chevaux), was a pioneering city-to-city motoring competition in 1894 which is sometimes described as the world's first competitive motor race. The contest was organised by the newspaper Le Petit Journal and run from Paris to Rouen in France on 22 July 1894. It was preceded by four days of vehicle exhibition and qualifying events that created great crowds and excitement. The eight 50 km (31 mi) qualifying events started near the Bois de Boulogne and comprised interwoven routes around Paris to select the entrants for the main 126 km (78 mi) event.

zh.s: 巴黎—鲁昂汽车赛（《小日报》无马车比赛，法语：Concours du “Petit Journal” Les Voitures sans Chevaux）是1894年举行的一场早期城市间汽车比赛，有时被称为世界上首场竞技性汽车赛事。比赛由《小日报》报社组织，于1894年7月22日从巴黎驶向法国鲁昂。比赛前举办了为期四天的车辆展览和资格赛，吸引了大批观众。八场50公里（31英里）资格赛从布洛涅森林附近出发，路线在巴黎周边交错，用于选出参加126公里（78英里）主赛的选手。

en.s: The 1913 Cherek Uprising was a peasant revolt that occurred in the Cherek Gorge of the Terek Oblast (present-day Kabardino-Balkaria), part of the Russian Empire, in July 1913. It was triggered by widespread discontent among Balkar peasants over the privatization and sale of communal forest lands by local feudal elites, known as taubii, particularly the Zhankhotov and Zhenokov families.

en.s: The Zolskoye Uprising (also known as the Zolskaya Revolt) was a peasant uprising that occurred in July 1913 in the village of Zolskaya and surrounding areas in the Terek Oblast of the Russian Empire. en.s: The Preparedness Day Bombing was a bombing in San Francisco, California on July 22, 1916, when the city held a parade in honor of Preparedness Day, in anticipation of the United States' imminent entry into World War I. During the parade a suitcase bomb was detonated, killing ten and wounding 40 in the worst such attack in San Francisco's history. Two labor leaders, Thomas Mooney and Warren K Billings, were convicted in separate trials and sentenced to death, later commuted to life in prison. Later investigations found the trials to have been marred by false testimony, and the men were released in 1939 and eventually pardoned.

zh.s: 1916年7月22日，美国加利福尼亚州旧金山举行备战日游行，人们当时预计美国即将参战。游行期间，一个手提箱炸弹被引爆，造成10人死亡、40人受伤，是旧金山历史上最严重的此类袭击。两名劳工领袖托马斯·穆尼和沃伦·K·比林斯分别受审，被判死刑，后来减为终身监禁。后续调查发现，两人的审判受到虚假证词影响；他们于1939年获释，之后得到赦免。

en.s: The Battle of al-Kafr was a military engagement between a French Army column commanded by Captain Gabriel Normand and the local Druze and Bedouin forces of Sultan al-Atrash on 22 July 1925. It occurred at Normand's encampment at the village of al-Kafr, in the southern Syrian region of Jabal al-Druze. The battle was a rout for the French, who were ambushed by Sultan's forces. Sultan's victory prompted an upswing of support for him by the Druze and by the end of July, his forces controlled Jabal al-Druze. The battle precipitated the countrywide Great Syrian Revolt.

zh.s: 1925年7月22日，法国陆军加布里埃尔·诺尔曼上尉率领的一支纵队，与苏丹·阿特拉什领导的当地德鲁兹人和贝都因人武装交战。战斗发生在法国军队设于叙利亚南部德鲁兹山地区卡夫尔村的营地。苏丹的部队设伏，击溃法军。苏丹获胜后，德鲁兹人对他的支持增加；到7月底，他的部队已控制德鲁兹山地区。这场战斗引发了席卷全国的叙利亚大起义。

en.s: John Herbert Dillinger (; June 22, 1903 – July 22, 1934) was an American gangster during the Great Depression. He commanded the Dillinger Gang, which was accused of robbing twenty-four banks and four police stations. Dillinger was imprisoned several times and escaped twice. He was charged with but not convicted of the murder of East Chicago, Indiana, police officer William O'Malley, who shot Dillinger in his bulletproof vest during a shootout; it was the only time Dillinger was charged with homicide.

en.s: Operation Fischreiher (German for heron) was an extension of Case Blue, part of the German invasion of the Soviet Union in World War II. General Friedrich Paulus' 6th Army, and part of the 4th Panzer Army under General Hermann Hoth, was to advance across the Don river towards the city of Stalingrad on the Western bend of the Volga river.

zh.s: “苍鹭”行动（Fischreiher在德语中意为“苍鹭”）是“蓝色方案”的延伸，属于第二次世界大战期间德国入侵苏联行动的一部分。弗里德里希·保卢斯将军的第6集团军和赫尔曼·霍特将军指挥的部分第4装甲集团军奉命渡过顿河，向伏尔加河西弯处的斯大林格勒推进。

en.s: The Allied invasion of Sicily, also known as the Battle of Sicily and Operation Husky, was a major campaign of World War II in which Allied forces invaded the Italian island of Sicily in July 1943 and took it from the Axis forces. The island was defended by the Italian 6th Army and the German XIV Panzer Corps.
en.n: World War II: Allied forces capture Palermo during the Allied invasion of Sicily.

zh.s: 盟军入侵西西里岛又称西西里战役或“哈士奇行动”，是第二次世界大战期间的一场重要战役。盟军于1943年7月入侵意大利西西里岛，并从轴心国手中夺取该岛。守岛部队包括意大利第6集团军和德国第14装甲军。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：盟军在入侵西西里岛期间攻占巴勒莫。

en.t: The Polish Committee of National Liberation publishes its manifesto, starting the period of Communist rule in Poland
en.s: The Polish Committee of National Liberation (Polish: Polski Komitet Wyzwolenia Narodowego, PKWN), also known as the Lublin Committee, was an executive governing authority established by the Soviet-backed communists in Poland at the later stage of World War II. It was officially proclaimed on 22 July 1944 in Chełm, installed on 26 July in Lublin and placed formally under the direction of the State National Council (Krajowa Rada Narodowa, KRN).

zh.t: 波兰民族解放委员会发表宣言，开启波兰共产主义统治时期
zh.s: 波兰民族解放委员会（波兰语：Polski Komitet Wyzwolenia Narodowego，简称PKWN），又称卢布林委员会，是二战后期由苏联支持的波兰共产党人建立的行政管理机构。1944年7月22日，委员会在海乌姆正式宣告成立；7月26日在卢布林就位，并正式接受国家民族委员会（Krajowa Rada Narodowa，简称KRN）领导。

en.s: The British administrative headquarters for Mandatory Palestine, housed in the southern wing of the King David Hotel in Jerusalem, were bombed in a terrorist attack on 22 July 1946, by the militant right-wing Zionist underground organization Irgun during the Jewish insurgency. Ninety-one people of various nationalities were killed, including Arabs, Britons and Jews, and 46 were injured.

zh.s: 巴勒斯坦托管地英国行政总部设在耶路撒冷大卫王酒店南翼。1946年7月22日，犹太人起义期间，右翼犹太复国主义地下组织伊尔贡发动恐怖袭击，对这处总部实施炸弹袭击。袭击造成91人死亡，包括阿拉伯人、英国人和犹太人，另有46人受伤。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Portugal on 22 July 1951, five years earlier than scheduled due to the death of President Óscar Carmona on 18 April 1951. Francisco Craveiro Lopes won the election unopposed after Manuel Quintão Meireles withdrew, while Rui Luís Gomes was removed from the ballot after being declared a communist by the Salazar dictatorship.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1951年7月22日举行总统选举，比原定时间提前了五年，原因是总统奥斯卡·卡莫纳于1951年4月18日去世。曼努埃尔·金唐·梅雷莱斯退出后，弗朗西斯科·克拉维罗·洛佩斯在没有对手的情况下当选；鲁伊·路易斯·戈麦斯则被萨拉查独裁政权认定为共产党人后取消候选资格。

en.s: The 1951 Svenska Cupen final took place on 22 July 1951 at Råsunda in Solna. It was contested between Allsvenskan sides Malmö FF and Djurgårdens IF. Djurgården played their first cup final ever, Malmö FF played their first final since 1947 and their fifth final in total. Malmö FF won their fourth title with a 2–1 victory.

zh.s: 1951年瑞典杯决赛于1951年7月22日在索尔纳的罗斯恩达球场举行，对阵双方是瑞典足球超级联赛球队马尔默FF和佐加顿斯IF。佐加顿斯首次打入杯赛决赛；马尔默FF自1947年以来首次进入决赛，也是队史第五次进入决赛。马尔默FF以2比1获胜，第四次夺冠。

en.t: Soviet space dogs: Dezik and Tsygan were launched into a sub-orbital spaceflight from Kapustin Yar and became the first dogs to fly in space and the first to safely return
en.s: Dezik (Russian: Дезик) and Tsygan (Цыган, lit. 'Gypsy') were the first two Soviet space dogs and, during their suborbital flight on July 22, 1951, the first dogs to fly into space. Dezik became the first two-time space traveler during a suborbital flight later in 1951, but was killed when the parachute failed to deploy.

zh.t: 苏联太空犬：杰济克和茨冈首次飞入太空并安全返回
zh.s: 杰济克（俄语：Дезик）和茨冈（Цыган，意为“吉卜赛人”）是苏联最早的两只太空犬。它们于1951年7月22日进行亚轨道飞行，成为首批进入太空的狗。1951年晚些时候，杰济克在另一次亚轨道飞行中成为首只两度进入太空的动物，但因降落伞未能打开而丧生。

en.t: Mariner 1 was launched by an Atlas-Agena rocket from Cape Canaveral's Pad 12 on July 22, 1962
en.s: Mariner 1 was the first spacecraft of NASA's interplanetary Mariner program, built to conduct the first American planetary flyby of Venus. Developed by Jet Propulsion Laboratory and originally planned to be a purpose-built probe launched summer 1962, Mariner 1's design was changed when the Centaur proved unavailable at that early date. Mariner 1 and its sibling spacecraft Mariner 2 were then adapted from the lighter Ranger lunar spacecraft.

zh.t: 水手1号由阿特拉斯–阿金纳火箭从卡纳维拉尔角12号发射台发射
zh.s: 水手1号是美国国家航空航天局“水手”行星探测计划的首个航天器，原计划飞掠金星，执行美国首次金星探测任务。它由喷气推进实验室研制，原定于1962年夏季发射。由于半人马座火箭当时无法使用，水手1号及其姊妹探测器水手2号改以较轻的“游骑兵”月球探测器为基础设计。

en.s: The 17th Locarno Film Festival was held from 22 July to 3 August 1964 in Locarno, Switzerland. This was the first year the festival was officially recognized and, in part, funded by the central Swiss government. This was a huge win for longtime artistic director of the festival, Vinicio Beretta, who also oversaw the festival being recognized by the Motion Picture Export Association of America (now known as the MPA) while maintaining the festival's official recognition by FIAPF.

The by-election was won by Labor candidate Gordon Scholes, a significant boost for Gough Whitlam, the new Opposition Leader.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院科里奥选区于1967年7月22日举行补选。此次补选由自由党议员休伯特·奥珀曼辞职引发。工党候选人戈登·斯科尔斯获胜，这对新任反对党领袖高夫·惠特拉姆是一次重要助力。

While the coup was led by officers associated with the Sudanese Communist Party (SCP), the party's central committee and its General Secretary, Abdel Khaliq Mahjub, had not given prior approval for the military action. The coup briefly toppled the administration of the Democratic Republic of the Sudan and established a Revolutionary Council.

On July 22, 1973, at 10:06 P.M. local time, the Boeing 707 took off from Faa'a International Airport in Papeete.

en.t: Japan completed its last reparation to the Philippines for war crimes committed during imperial Japan's conquest of the country in the Second World War
en.s: The Japanese Empire occupied the Commonwealth of the Philippines between 1942 and 1945 during World War II. Japan invaded the Philippines on December 8, 1941, ten hours after the attack on Pearl Harbor. As at Pearl Harbor, American aircraft were severely damaged in the initial Japanese attack. Lacking air cover, the American Asiatic Fleet in the Philippines withdrew to Java on December 12, 1941.

zh.t: 日本完成对菲律宾的最后一笔战争赔偿，赔偿内容涉及第二次世界大战期间日本帝国征服菲律宾犯下的战争罪行
zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，日本帝国于1942年至1945年占领菲律宾自治领。日本于1941年12月8日入侵菲律宾，比珍珠港袭击晚10小时。与珍珠港遇袭情况类似，美国飞机在日本最初的空袭中遭到严重破坏。由于缺乏空中掩护，美国亚洲舰队于1941年12月12日撤往爪哇。

en.s: A general election was held between Saturday, 8 July and Saturday, 22 July 1978 for members of the 5th Parliament of Malaysia. Voting took place in all 154 parliamentary constituencies of Malaysia, each electing one Member of Parliament to the Dewan Rakyat, the dominant house of Parliament. State elections also took place in 276 state constituencies in 10 (out of 13, except Kelantan, Sabah and Sarawak) states of Malaysia on the same day. It was Hussein Onn's first election since he became the country's third Prime Minister. His Barisan Nasional Party emerged victorious with 131 of the 154 seats in Parliament.

zh.s: 马来西亚于1978年7月8日至22日举行大选，选出第五届国会下议院议员。全国154个国会选区均举行投票，每个选区选出一名下议院议员。同日，马来西亚13个州中的10个州（吉兰丹、沙巴和砂拉越除外）也在276个州议会选区举行选举。这是侯赛因·奥恩出任马来西亚第三任总理后的首次大选。他领导的国民阵线获胜，在154个国会议席中赢得131席。

en.s: The Assadist–Saddamist conflict, also known as the Ba'ath Party intraconflict, was a conflict and ideological rivalry between the Assadist Syrian-led Ba'ath Party and its subgroups, loyal to Ba'athist Syria, and the Saddamist Iraqi-led Ba'ath Party and its subgroups, loyal to Ba'athist Iraq. The conflict continued ideologically even after the U.S.-led invasion of Iraq and subsequent toppling of President Saddam Hussein, and ended after the fall of the Assad regime to a Syrian opposition offensive.

zh.s: 阿萨德派—萨达姆派冲突又称复兴党内部冲突，交战双方是由叙利亚阿萨德派领导、效忠复兴党叙利亚的党派及其分支，以及由伊拉克萨达姆派领导、效忠复兴党伊拉克的党派及其分支。美国入侵伊拉克并推翻萨达姆总统后，这场冲突仍以意识形态斗争的形式延续；叙利亚反对派攻势推翻阿萨德政权后，冲突才结束。

en.t: 1981 South Africa rugby union tour of New Zealand and the United States
en.s: The 1981 South African rugby tour (known in New Zealand as the 1981 Springbok Tour, and in South Africa as the Rebel Tour) polarised opinions and inspired widespread protests across New Zealand. The controversy also extended to the United States, where the South African rugby team continued their tour after departing New Zealand. Apartheid had made South Africa an international pariah, and other countries were strongly discouraged from having sporting contacts with it.
en.n: The first game of the 1981 South Africa rugby union tour of New Zealand and the United States is held in Gisborne, New Zealand.

zh.t: 1981年南非橄榄球队新西兰和美国巡回赛
zh.s: 1981年南非橄榄球队巡回赛在新西兰称为“1981年跳羚巡回赛”，在南非称为“反叛者巡回赛”。此次巡回赛引发不同立场的争论，并在新西兰各地激起广泛抗议。南非队离开新西兰后继续在美国巡回，这场争议也延伸到美国。种族隔离政策使南非遭到国际社会排斥，其他国家也被强烈劝阻与其开展体育交流。
zh.n: 1981年南非橄榄球队新西兰和美国巡回赛的首场比赛在新西兰吉斯伯恩举行。

en.s: Martial law in Poland (Polish: Stan wojenny w Polsce) was in effect between 13 December 1981 and 22 July 1983. The government of the Polish People's Republic drastically restricted everyday life by introducing martial law and a military junta in an attempt to counter political opposition, in particular the Solidarity movement. en.s: The Eddisbury by-election, 1999 was a parliamentary by-election held on 22 July 1999 for the British House of Commons constituency of Eddisbury in Cheshire. On 25 May 1999 the Foreign and Commonwealth Office announced the appointment of Eddisbury's Member of Parliament (MP), the Rt. Hon. Sir Alastair Goodlad, as High Commissioner to the Commonwealth of Australia. This created a vacancy in the seat which Sir Alastair had retained as the Conservative candidate in the 1997 general election. en.s: Uday and Qusay Hussein, sons of deposed Iraqi president Saddam Hussein, were killed during an American military operation conducted on 22 July 2003, in the city of Mosul, Iraq. en.t: Chandrayaan-2, the second lunar exploration mission developed by Indian Space Research Organisation after Chandrayaan-1 is launched from Satish Dhawan Space Centre in a GSLV Mark III M1. It consists of a lunar orbiter, and also included the Vikram lander, and the Pragyan lunar rover
en.s: Chandrayaan-2 (; from Sanskrit: Chandra, "Moon" and yāna, "craft, vehicle") is the second lunar exploration mission developed by ISRO after Chandrayaan-1. It consists of a lunar orbiter, the Vikram lunar lander, and the Pragyan rover, all of which were developed in India. The main scientific objective is to map and study the variations in lunar surface composition, as well as the location and abundance of lunar water.
